[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-zr[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Make gate approval and notification dismissal respond promptly[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Publish durable tale and epic approval decisions and refresh ACE [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and Telegram promptly without waiting for archive publication or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]successor launch, while preserving execution recovery and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exactly-once follow-up ownership.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-zr[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-zr/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Measure approval stages and replace full-history gate lookup[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]bounded-gate-resolution: In sase-core and sase, instrument the approval [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]boundaries from submission through paint and replace [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]find_gate_shell_by_gate_id's full-history scan with an indexed exact [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gate-id lookup exposed through the Rust binding. Maintain the lookup on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gate creation and marker mutation, handle old indexes off the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]interactive path, and test that lookup work stays bounded as unrelated [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]history grows. Resolve the exact owning shell, not a successor [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inheriting its gate id. Preserve project scoping and newest-real-shell [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]behavior. Run focused Rust/PyO3 and Python tests and each changed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]repository's required checks.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Separate durable decision acceptance from slow execution[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]durable-approval-publication[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bounded-gate-resolution[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]durable-approval-publication: Implement shared acceptance and execution [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]policy in sase-core with thin sase orchestration. Validate and durably [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reserve one decision and its supervised proc before publishing approval [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and dismissing the notification. Keep response.json's existing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]execution-complete contract and required host archive receipts; project [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]accepted plan decisions separately from terminal shell state. Route [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ACE-facing plan APIs, CLI, mobile, and auto approval through the same [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]policy. Move archive/network/launch work behind the acceptance boundary,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]publish terminal shell state before follow-up, and make crash recovery [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and retry ownership explicit. Preserve branch inputs, source, archive [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]protocol, wait and coder choices, cancellation, and partial attempts. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Prove acceptance remains visible while archive/launch barriers are [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]blocked, and prove duplicate or racing submissions cannot duplicate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]work.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Apply decision and notification changes through ACE's fast [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]path[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]ace-immediate-projection[dim] · [dim][/dim]after durable-approval-publication[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ace-immediate-projection: Update neutral plan and generic gate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]submissions in sase to use the shared durable operation and consume its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]acceptance result. Refresh the exact gate shell, planner, and family [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plus the cached notification row and indicator promptly, including [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]approvals from Telegram/CLI/mobile. Bypass the broad agent-load cadence [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]only for bounded decision deltas, reuse existing coalescing and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pump-free refresh helpers, and protect new state from older snapshots. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Keep all disk, subprocess and lock work off Textual's event loop and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]serial message pump. Verify folded/filtered/off-tab rows, stale [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]overrides, repeated actions, failure recovery and input responsiveness.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Decouple Telegram acknowledgements and cleanup from gate [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]execution[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]telegram-prompt-actions[dim] · [dim][/dim]after durable-approval-publication[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]telegram-prompt-actions: In the sase-telegram repository, replace [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]synchronous resolve_gate_response execution and settlement in inbound [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]handlers with the shared durable submission API. Acknowledge callbacks [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]promptly, remove or disable accepted decision keyboards, persist [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]completion/error delivery and keyboard-cleanup retries, and continue [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]processing later updates while gate execution runs. Reconcile externally[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]accepted gates independently of slow handlers and outbound PDF/message [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]delivery. Test authentication, duplicate callbacks, restart recovery, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rate limits, input/feedback flows and cross-surface dismissal without [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]real Telegram sends. Preserve the existing polling entry point for the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]receiver phase to integrate.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Remove Telegram's periodic polling delay[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]telegram-continuous-receiver[dim] · [dim][/dim]after telegram-prompt-actions[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]telegram-continuous-receiver: Measure the effective inbound cadence and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]integrate a supervised, single-owner long-poll receiver with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-telegram's existing chop entry point. Preserve --once, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]disabled-credential behavior and axe stop/config lifecycle. Keep local [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cleanup independent of the network poll, durably claim actionable [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]updates before advancing offsets, and preserve ordering for mutable [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]question/input progress and non-gate launches. Test receiver restart, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]two competing pollers, offset replay, rate limits, idle CPU and prompt [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cleanup during a long poll. Reuse SASE supervision rather than adding an[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unsupervised process or new queue service.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Verify latency, recovery, and coordinated rollout[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]integrated-latency-verification[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ace-immediate-projection, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]telegram-continuous-receiver[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]integrated-latency-verification: Exercise both approval tiers across [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ACE, Telegram, CLI and mobile using the matched sase-core binding and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the full combined implementation. Produce before/after stage timings and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bounded-work evidence, including blocked archive/launch workers and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]large history. Run just check in every changed repository and sase's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]combined-tree just check-full through sase_monitor. Verify restart, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]duplicate, cancellation, partial-command and archive-failure behavior. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Document rollout order, the Telegram receiver lifecycle/configuration, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]latency measurements and any remaining network limits. Remove temporary [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]epic scaffolding before landing.[/#D7D7AF]
